manifest.reviewPolicy: All new debit BR/TS/TC/TD records are REVIEW_REQUIRED; shared 10.1 rules remain draft references; TDs are non-executable design placeholders; no approval or coverage credit is asserted.

businessRequirements.title: Debit processing does not validate expiration and still requests online authorization
businessRequirements.requirement: When a card is processed as debit, the device does not validate expiration and requests online authorization regardless of the card's expiration date.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The device does not perform expiration date validation on a debit card when the card is processed as a debit transaction.

businessRequirements.title: Debit Completion is processed once and cannot be reversed or resubmitted
businessRequirements.requirement: A Debit Card Completion can be processed only one time by BUYPASS/debit networks and cannot be reversed or processed again by the device.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: When processing a Debit Card Completion transaction, the transaction can only be processed one time by BUYPASS and debit networks.

businessRequirements.title: Debit Completion with no response retries on next dial or after thirty minutes
businessRequirements.requirement: When BUYPASS returns no response to a Debit Completion, resend on the next dial attempt or 30 minutes later, whichever occurs first.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: In the event the device sends a Debit Card Completion transaction to BUYPASS and does not receive a response, the device should resend the request on the next dial attempt or 30 minutes later—whichever occurs first.

businessRequirements.title: Debit Completion decline code 24 means already captured and updates totals as approved
businessRequirements.requirement: A response code 1 with Decline Code 24 is treated as already captured on BUYPASS and the device updates totals as approved.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: If the device receives a Response Code value of 1 (indicating a "decline") and a Decline Code value of 24 in the transaction response message, then the device should treat the response as already captured on BUYPASS and update the device totals as "approved."

businessRequirements.title: Any BUYPASS response ends Debit Completion retry attempts
businessRequirements.requirement: Any response, approved or declined, ends retries for that Debit Completion.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Any response from BUYPASS to a Debit Card Completion transaction should end attempts to retry a Debit Card Completion whether "approved" or "declined."

businessRequirements.title: Debit transactions require PIN except Purchase Reversal
businessRequirements.requirement: PIN entry is required for debit transactions except Purchase Reversal.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: All transactions—except the Purchase Reversal transaction—require PIN entry.

businessRequirements.title: Debit PIN uses DES-compliant entry and DUKPT PIN encryption
businessRequirements.requirement: When PIN is required for debit, entry occurs on a DES-compliant device and is encrypted using DUKPT PIN encryption.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: the entry of the customer PIN is required on a DES- compliant entry device, and it must be encrypted using the DUKPT PIN encryption method.

businessRequirements.title: Manual card entry is prohibited for debit transactions
businessRequirements.requirement: The device does not offer manual entry for debit transactions.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Manual entry is not allowed on a debit card transaction.

businessRequirements.title: Unreadable debit magnetic stripe prompts up to three swipes then ends with clerk message
businessRequirements.requirement: After up to three unsuccessful swipe attempts, the device displays a message to the clerk and ends the transaction; it does not fall back to manual entry.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: If the device is unable to read the card's magnetic strip, it should prompt the user to swipe the card again—up to three times.

businessRequirements.title: POS debit processing supports the documented debit transaction set
businessRequirements.requirement: Point-of-sale debit supports Purchase/Capture, Purchase with Cashback, Purchase Reversal, Authorization Only, Merchandise Return, Time-out Reversal (except debit Completion TOR), Void of Merchandise Return, Balance Inquiry, Partial Approval, and Authorization Only Reversal.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The following point-of-sale transactions are supported for debit card processing:

businessRequirements.title: Customer-activated debit supports its documented transaction set
businessRequirements.requirement: CAT debit supports Purchase/Capture, Authorization Only, Time-out Reversal, Partial Approval, and Authorization Only Reversal.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The following customer-activated transactions are supported for debit card processing:

businessRequirements.title: Debit partial approval returns code F, approved amount, balance, and remaining-balance prompt
businessRequirements.requirement: When Partial Approval Indicator 1 is sent, a supporting debit network returns code F and the approved amount; POS prompts for remaining balance and issuer-returned balance is in Segment 112.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: A Response Code (Element No. 83) value of F (Indicates “approval, partial amount approved.”)

businessRequirements.title: Debit partial approval applies to documented POS/CAT contexts
businessRequirements.requirement: Partial Approval is supported for POS Purchase, POS Purchase with Cashback, POS Authorization Only, and CAT Authorization Only.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: POS Purchase with Cashback

businessRequirements.title: Interlink cashback support requires merchant support for partial approval
businessRequirements.requirement: The source states Interlink requires merchants supporting cashback to also support Partial Approval.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Interlink requires that merchants supporting cashback must also support Partial Approval transactions.

businessRequirements.title: Partial approval of debit purchase with cashback applies to purchase amount only
businessRequirements.requirement: When a debit Purchase with Cashback is partially approved, the approved amount is for the purchase only and does not include cashback.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: cashback is partially approved, then the partially approved amount will be for the purchase only and not cashback.

businessRequirements.title: Debit reversal of a partially approved transaction uses original approved amount
businessRequirements.requirement: The reversal amount equals the amount approved in the original response when the debit transaction was partially approved.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

businessRequirements.title: Debit timeout reversal preserves approved amount and original Sequence Number
businessRequirements.requirement: For partial approval, debit TOR uses the amount approved in the original response and the Sequence Number from the original request.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The amount in a TOR request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

businessRequirements.title: Debit Authorization Only Reversal covers POS type 3 and CAT type 5
businessRequirements.requirement: Debit authorization-only reversal applies to POS Authorization Only transaction type 3 and CAT Authorization Only type 5; common timing and matching rules are cross-referenced from Section 10.1 drafts pending review.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: POS Authorization Only (Transaction Type code “3”)

businessRequirements.title: Healthcare auto-substantiation is supported for PIN debit issuers
businessRequirements.requirement: The Section 10.2 healthcare service applies to supported PIN debit issuers and FSA/HRA purchase contexts; common healthcare requirements are referenced from Section 10.1 drafts pending review.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The Healthcare Auto-Substantiation Service provided by credit card issuers (Amex®, Discover® Network, MasterCard®, Visa®) and PIN debit card issuers, is supported by these specifications.

businessRequirements.title: Debit healthcare request includes MSDI, Partial Approval Indicator, and Product Code
businessRequirements.requirement: The FSA/HRA debit request carries MSDI in Segment 111, Partial Approval Indicator in Segment 100, and Product Code Segment 102; common field behavior reuses Section 10.1 healthcare draft rules.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: FSA/HRA transaction requests include the following data fields:

businessRequirements.title: Debit healthcare supports purchase, reversal, return, and timeout types
businessRequirements.requirement: FSA/HRA debit supports Purchase/Capture, Purchase Reversal, Merchandise Return, and Time-out Reversal; detailed shared processing rules reference Section 10.1 healthcare drafts.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Purchase/Capture

businessRequirements.title: Approved debit healthcare receipt includes QHP indicator and subtotal
businessRequirements.requirement: Approved FSA/HRA debit receipts print the QHP item indicator and subtotal including taxes and discounts; other receipt requirements are inherited by reference.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The debit card receipt requirements listed in section 10.2.4, “Receipt Requirements,” apply to FSA/HRA card transactions.

businessRequirements.title: Debit receipt may print PIN USED when a PIN is entered
businessRequirements.requirement: A debit receipt may optionally include a PIN USED message when PIN was entered.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Optionally, a PIN USED message can be printed on transaction receipts when a PIN is entered.

businessRequirements.title: Debit receipt requires no signature line and may show SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED
businessRequirements.requirement: A debit receipt does not require a signature line; a SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message is optional.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: No signature line is required when printing a debit receipt.

businessRequirements.title: PIN block data is excluded from debit follow-on transactions
businessRequirements.requirement: PIN block data is not included in Debit Completion or Reversal follow-on transactions.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: PIN block data is not included in follow-on transactions (Completions/Reversals).

businessRequirements.title: Debit processing sends Track 2 as the default track to BUYPASS
businessRequirements.requirement: For electronic debit transactions, Track 2 is the default track sent to BUYPASS.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The default track that is sent to BUYPASS should be Track 2.

businessRequirements.title: Debit follow-on host message contains account number and equals-delimited expiration only
businessRequirements.requirement: For debit Completions, POS Purchase Reversals, Time-out Reversals, POS Cancellations, and Cancellations, host card data uses Account Number followed by '=' and four-digit YYMM expiration, with no trailing Card Discretionary Data.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: The host message should only contain the following card data information in the Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data fields:

businessRequirements.title: Debit Track 2 is retained in the In Flight Table only during transaction processing
businessRequirements.requirement: Track 2 may remain in the In Flight Table while the debit transaction is in process and is removed when the transaction completes; shared storage/clearing rules reference Section 10.1 drafts.

sourceEvidence.verbatimExcerpt: Track 2 data is kept in this table while the transaction is in process.

testCases.reviewObjective: When a card is processed as debit, the device does not validate expiration and requests online authorization regardless of the card's expiration date.
A Debit Card Completion can be processed only one time by BUYPASS/debit networks and cannot be reversed or processed again by the device.
When BUYPASS returns no response to a Debit Completion, resend on the next dial attempt or 30 minutes later, whichever occurs first.
A response code 1 with Decline Code 24 is treated as already captured on BUYPASS and the device updates totals as approved.
Any response, approved or declined, ends retries for that Debit Completion.
PIN entry is required for debit transactions except Purchase Reversal.
When PIN is required for debit, entry occurs on a DES-compliant device and is encrypted using DUKPT PIN encryption.
The device does not offer manual entry for debit transactions.
After up to three unsuccessful swipe attempts, the device displays a message to the clerk and ends the transaction; it does not fall back to manual entry.

Point-of-sale debit supports Purchase/Capture, Purchase with Cashback, Purchase Reversal, Authorization Only, Merchandise Return, Time-out Reversal (except debit Completion TOR), Void of Merchandise Return, Balance Inquiry, Partial Approval, and Authorization Only Reversal.
CAT debit supports Purchase/Capture, Authorization Only, Time-out Reversal, Partial Approval, and Authorization Only Reversal.
When Partial Approval Indicator 1 is sent, a supporting debit network returns code F and the approved amount; POS prompts for remaining balance and issuer-returned balance is in Segment 112.
Partial Approval is supported for POS Purchase, POS Purchase with Cashback, POS Authorization Only, and CAT Authorization Only.
The source states Interlink requires merchants supporting cashback to also support Partial Approval.
When a debit Purchase with Cashback is partially approved, the approved amount is for the purchase only and does not include cashback.
The reversal amount equals the amount approved in the original response when the debit transaction was partially approved.
For partial approval, debit TOR uses the amount approved in the original response and the Sequence Number from the original request.

Debit authorization-only reversal applies to POS Authorization Only transaction type 3 and CAT Authorization Only type 5; common timing and matching rules are cross-referenced from Section 10.1 drafts pending review.
The Section 10.2 healthcare service applies to supported PIN debit issuers and FSA/HRA purchase contexts; common healthcare requirements are referenced from Section 10.1 drafts pending review.
The FSA/HRA debit request carries MSDI in Segment 111, Partial Approval Indicator in Segment 100, and Product Code Segment 102; common field behavior reuses Section 10.1 healthcare draft rules.
FSA/HRA debit supports Purchase/Capture, Purchase Reversal, Merchandise Return, and Time-out Reversal; detailed shared processing rules reference Section 10.1 healthcare drafts.
Approved FSA/HRA debit receipts print the QHP item indicator and subtotal including taxes and discounts; other receipt requirements are inherited by reference.
A debit receipt may optionally include a PIN USED message when PIN was entered.
A debit receipt does not require a signature line; a SIGNATURE NOT REQUIRED message is optional.
PIN block data is not included in Debit Completion or Reversal follow-on transactions.
For electronic debit transactions, Track 2 is the default track sent to BUYPASS.

For debit Completions, POS Purchase Reversals, Time-out Reversals, POS Cancellations, and Cancellations, host card data uses Account Number followed by '=' and four-digit YYMM expiration, with no trailing Card Discretionary Data.
Track 2 may remain in the In Flight Table while the debit transaction is in process and is removed when the transaction completes; shared storage/clearing rules reference Section 10.1 drafts.
